Quarterly Report

Receipts were 12% higher than in the same quarter last year, and the printed report's two columns read as ordinary paragraphs once the layout markers are gone.

Regional totals

North 412, South 388, East 301 and West 276. The figures are in thousands of units and are unaudited.

Notes

The report is provisional. A revised edition is expected in the next quarter, after the audit closes.
